name: phone_capabilities
description: First call: inspect permissions, accessibility, lock/power state, phone accounts, operation_prefix and nonce length bounds. Direct Android APIs are preferred.

name: phone_observe
description: Observe screen nodes and optional screenshot. Coordinates use full device dimensions; resized images need scaling. Screenshot is omitted by default. Get a fresh snapshot before every action.

name: phone_act
description: Perform an Android screen action using a recent snapshot_id. Prefer exact unique semantic selectors for click/type/scroll. Enter uses real IME action. Input acceptance is not task completion. Reuse operation_id and identical arguments after network loss. operation_id must be phone_capabilities.operation_prefix + underscore + a unique 8..48 character nonce; reuse identical IDs and arguments after uncertain results.

operation_id.description: Current phone_capabilities.operation_prefix + '_' + a unique 8..48 character nonce using only ASCII letters, digits, '_' or '-'. Include owner/generation/action/attempt or a timestamp for uniqueness. A valid suffix example is _type_0001; never reuse the example across actions. Preserve identical IDs/arguments after uncertain results.

name: phone_apps
description: List visible launcher apps without screen navigation.

name: phone_open_app
description: Request app launch. Verify foreground package afterward: OEM background restrictions can reject a launch silently. operation_id must be phone_capabilities.operation_prefix + underscore + a unique 8..48 character nonce; reuse identical IDs and arguments after uncertain results.

Preserve identical IDs/arguments after uncertain results.

name: phone_open_url
description: Open a validated HTTP(S) URL via Android ACTION_VIEW on the private agent display. Verify the actual browser after launch; not a page-read API.

name: phone_calendar_events

name: phone_calendar_create

name: phone_operation
description: Inspect durable operation result and per-part SMS sent/delivery receipt codes after timeouts or network loss.

name: phone_screen
description: Release this conversation's virtual display when its UI work is finished. Displays are acquired automatically on the first screen interaction; SMS, calling and other direct Android APIs never allocate one. Up to three displays run concurrently; further UI work waits until a display is freed.

name: phone_batch
description: Validate up to 8 direct tool calls before execution. Ordered screen mutations. Every mutation has its own operation_id. Stops on the first error. Not atomic. Retry with SAME IDs after a lost response; never replay unknown outcomes.
